examples.en: She works as a translator for an international company.
examples.zh: 她在一家跨国公司当翻译。

examples.en: The team hired a strategist to plan their long-term goals.
examples.zh: 团队聘请了一位战略家来规划长远目标。

examples.en: The company registered a trademark to protect its brand.
examples.zh: 这家公司注册了一个商标来保护其品牌。

examples.en: Nowadays, most people read the news on their phones.
examples.zh: 如今，大多数人都在手机上看新闻。

examples.en: The flood forced people to displace from their homes.
examples.zh: 洪水迫使人们离开自己的家园。

examples.en: The two countries argued over a territorial dispute.
examples.zh: 两国就一场领土争端发生了争执。

examples.en: The law now protects the rights of homosexual couples.
examples.zh: 法律现在保护同性恋伴侣的权利。

examples.en: Our city is a lively multicultural community.
examples.zh: 我们的城市是一个充满活力的多元文化社区。

examples.en: The librarian had to catalogue all the new books.
examples.zh: 图书管理员必须把所有新书编入目录。

examples.en: Many birds nest in the grassy marsh near the river.
examples.zh: 许多鸟在河边长满草的沼泽里筑巢。

examples.en: Polar bears live in the cold Arctic region.
examples.zh: 北极熊生活在寒冷的北极地区。

examples.en: There has been a gradual improvement in her health.
examples.zh: 她的健康状况一直在逐渐好转。

examples.en: He enjoys long, solitary walks in the mountains.
examples.zh: 他喜欢在山里进行漫长而独自的散步。

examples.en: Please bring all the documentation needed for the visa.
examples.zh: 请带上申请签证所需的所有文件。

examples.en: She mentioned the news casually during dinner.
examples.zh: 她在晚餐时随口提到了这个消息。

examples.en: The little puppy chased its tail in the garden.
examples.zh: 那只小狗在花园里追着自己的尾巴跑。

examples.en: The angler sat by the lake hoping to catch a fish.
examples.zh: 那个钓鱼人坐在湖边，希望能钓到一条鱼。

examples.en: The company faced a slump in sales last year.
examples.zh: 去年这家公司面临销售额的暴跌。

examples.en: I will read the remainder of the book tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天会读完这本书剩下的部分。

examples.en: The median income in this town is quite low.
examples.zh: 这个镇的收入中位数相当低。

examples.en: There is a prohibition against smoking in the building.
examples.zh: 这栋大楼内禁止吸烟。

examples.en: His voice was almost inaudible in the noisy room.
examples.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里，他的声音几乎听不见。

examples.en: Your application is still pending a final decision.
examples.zh: 你的申请仍在等待最终决定。

examples.en: She added some fresh coconut to the cake.
examples.zh: 她往蛋糕里加了一些新鲜的椰子。

examples.en: He has a strong dislike for cold weather.
examples.zh: 他非常讨厌寒冷的天气。

examples.en: The police officer showed his badge at the door.
examples.zh: 那位警官在门口出示了他的徽章。

examples.en: She felt a deep void after her best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 好朋友搬走后，她感到一种深深的空虚。

examples.en: The quiet island felt like a tropical paradise.
examples.zh: 那座宁静的岛屿宛如热带天堂。

examples.en: We ate fresh seafood at a restaurant by the sea.
examples.zh: 我们在海边的一家餐厅吃了新鲜的海鲜。

examples.en: The kitchen counter is made of polished granite.
examples.zh: 这个厨房台面是用磨光的花岗岩做的。

examples.en: The famous theologian wrote many books about faith.
examples.zh: 这位著名的神学家写了许多关于信仰的书。

examples.en: The waves slowly erode the rocks along the coast.
examples.zh: 海浪慢慢地侵蚀着海岸边的岩石。

examples.en: I could hear the soft hum of the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 我能听到冰箱发出轻柔的嗡嗡声。

examples.en: This jacket is made of synthetic material.
examples.zh: 这件夹克是用合成材料制成的。

examples.en: She could hardly restrain her excitement at the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息，她几乎无法抑制自己的兴奋。

examples.en: He poured sweet syrup over his pancakes.
examples.zh: 他把甜糖浆浇在煎饼上。

examples.en: A teaching qualification is required for this job.
examples.zh: 这份工作需要教师资格。

examples.en: She placed the photo frame on her desktop.
examples.zh: 她把相框放在了桌面上。

examples.en: Coffee is my favorite morning beverage.
examples.zh: 咖啡是我最喜欢的早晨饮料。

examples.en: We attended the premiere of the new movie last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们参加了这部新电影的首映。

examples.en: The clever bird can mimic human speech.
examples.zh: 这只聪明的鸟能模仿人说话。

examples.en: He parked his car illegally near the school.
examples.zh: 他把车违法地停在了学校附近。

examples.en: I am not wholly convinced by his explanation.
examples.zh: 我并不完全相信他的解释。

examples.en: The people fought against years of oppression.
examples.zh: 人民反抗了多年的压迫。

examples.en: The soldiers carried enough ammunition for the battle.
examples.zh: 士兵们携带了足够战斗所需的弹药。

examples.en: I spent all morning filling out the paperwork.
examples.zh: 我花了一整个上午填写文书工作。

examples.en: The sharp needle can easily pierce the cloth.
examples.zh: 这根尖针能轻易刺穿布料。

examples.en: This new car is a hybrid of two designs.
examples.zh: 这款新车是两种设计的混合体。

examples.en: On weekends I like to indulge in a long nap.
examples.zh: 周末我喜欢尽情地睡个长觉。

examples.en: The little boy can be a real pest sometimes.
examples.zh: 这个小男孩有时真是个讨厌鬼。

examples.en: We stayed in a cozy lodge near the forest.
examples.zh: 我们住在森林附近一间舒适的小屋里。

examples.en: An interim manager will lead the team for now.
examples.zh: 暂时将由一位临时经理来领导团队。

examples.en: Wild horses ran freely across the open prairie.
examples.zh: 野马在开阔的大草原上自由奔跑。

examples.en: Scientists measure changes in atmospheric pressure.
examples.zh: 科学家测量大气压力的变化。

examples.en: The morning train was full of tired commuters.
examples.zh: 早班火车上挤满了疲惫的通勤者。

examples.en: She gave the switch a quick flick to turn off the light.
examples.zh: 她快速一拨开关，把灯关掉了。

examples.en: I watched the latest episode of the TV serial.
examples.zh: 我看了那部电视连续剧的最新一集。

examples.en: The newspaper published an investigative report.
examples.zh: 这家报纸发表了一篇调查报道。

examples.en: We rolled the dice to decide who would go first.
examples.zh: 我们掷骰子来决定谁先走。

examples.en: In the story, a kind dwarf helped the lost girl.
examples.zh: 在故事里，一个善良的矮人帮助了迷路的女孩。

examples.en: She picked a ripe pear from the tree.
examples.zh: 她从树上摘了一个成熟的梨。

examples.en: My grandfather is a baby boomer born in the 1950s.
examples.zh: 我祖父是出生于20世纪50年代的婴儿潮一代。

examples.en: Her results surpass everyone's expectations.
examples.zh: 她的成绩超出了所有人的预期。

examples.en: The night sky seemed to stretch on into infinite space.
examples.zh: 夜空仿佛延伸进无限的太空之中。

examples.en: They love to share gossip about their neighbors.
examples.zh: 他们喜欢分享关于邻居的闲言碎语。

examples.en: Cyclists wear reflective jackets at night for safety.
examples.zh: 骑车人晚上穿反光夹克以保安全。

examples.en: His later words seem to contradict his earlier promise.
examples.zh: 他后来的话似乎与他先前的承诺相矛盾。

examples.en: The athlete has strong, muscular arms.
examples.zh: 这名运动员有着强壮、肌肉发达的手臂。

examples.en: Too much plastic waste ends up in the landfill.
examples.zh: 太多的塑料垃圾最终被运到了垃圾填埋场。

examples.en: My daily commute to work takes about an hour.
examples.zh: 我每天上班通勤大约要花一个小时。

examples.en: The story explores both temporal and eternal themes.
examples.zh: 这个故事探讨了世俗与永恒两种主题。

examples.en: The two nations signed a bilateral trade agreement.
examples.zh: 两国签署了一项双边贸易协定。

examples.en: She bent down to pluck a flower from the field.
examples.zh: 她弯下腰从田野里摘了一朵花。

examples.en: The lunar surface is covered with deep craters.
examples.zh: 月球表面布满了深深的陨石坑。

examples.en: There is a discrepancy between the two reports.
examples.zh: 这两份报告之间存在差异。

examples.en: He was too shocked to utter a single word.
examples.zh: 他震惊得说不出一个字来。

examples.en: We had breakfast on the sunny patio.
examples.zh: 我们在阳光明媚的露台上吃了早餐。

examples.en: Please accept my sincere thanks for your help.
examples.zh: 请接受我对你的帮助的真挚感谢。

examples.en: She is taking an intermediate English course.
examples.zh: 她正在上一门中级英语课程。

examples.en: My roommate and I share a small apartment.
examples.zh: 我和室友合住一间小公寓。

examples.en: The sudden demise of the king shocked the nation.
examples.zh: 国王的突然驾崩震惊了整个国家。

examples.en: Reading widely can enrich your knowledge.
examples.zh: 广泛阅读能丰富你的知识。

examples.en: The crowd began to chant the team's name.
examples.zh: 人群开始高呼这支队伍的名字。

examples.en: The submarine dived deep beneath the waves.
examples.zh: 潜水艇潜入了波涛之下的深处。

examples.en: The new plan was overwhelmingly approved by voters.
examples.zh: 这项新计划得到了选民的压倒性支持。

examples.en: The baby was premature and stayed in hospital.
examples.zh: 这个婴儿是早产儿，留在了医院里。

examples.en: A tout tried to sell us concert tickets outside.
examples.zh: 一个票贩子试图在外面把演唱会门票卖给我们。

examples.en: The volcano left a huge crater on the mountain.
examples.zh: 火山在山上留下了一个巨大的火山口。

examples.en: The children slept comfortably in their warm beds.
examples.zh: 孩子们在温暖的床上舒服地睡着了。

examples.en: The exploitation of the forest harmed local wildlife.
examples.zh: 对森林的开发损害了当地的野生动物。

examples.en: He proudly wore the team's red jersey.
examples.zh: 他自豪地穿上了球队的红色运动衫。

examples.en: The clown made all the children laugh.
examples.zh: 小丑逗得所有孩子都笑了。

examples.en: Rainwater flowed into the ditch beside the road.
examples.zh: 雨水流进了路边的沟渠里。

examples.en: Firstly it is cheap, and secondly it is easy to use.
examples.zh: 首先它便宜，其次它使用方便。

examples.en: She bought a fresh loaf of bread this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上买了一条新鲜的面包。

examples.en: He rested his head on a soft cushion.
examples.zh: 他把头靠在一个柔软的垫子上。

examples.en: I only vaguely remember meeting him before.
examples.zh: 我只是隐约记得以前见过他。

examples.en: We walked home through the quiet twilight.
examples.zh: 我们在静谧的暮色中走回了家。

examples.en: Many changes happen during adolescence.
examples.zh: 在青春期会发生许多变化。

examples.en: The text was too hard for me to comprehend.
examples.zh: 这篇文章太难，我无法理解。

examples.en: Please dispose of the trash in the right bin.
examples.zh: 请把垃圾扔到正确的垃圾桶里。

examples.en: She used a key to unlock the front door.
examples.zh: 她用钥匙打开了前门的锁。

examples.en: A squirrel hid some nuts under the tree.
examples.zh: 一只松鼠在树下藏了一些坚果。

examples.en: He seemed destined to become a great writer.
examples.zh: 他似乎注定要成为一位伟大的作家。

examples.en: The author earns royalty from every book sold.
examples.zh: 作者从每卖出一本书中赚取版税。

examples.en: The chef prepared a superb meal for the guests.
examples.zh: 厨师为客人准备了一顿极好的饭菜。

examples.en: The new staff are friendly and responsive to questions.
examples.zh: 新员工很友好，对问题反应也很积极。

examples.en: Her anger at the news was perfectly understandable.
examples.zh: 她对这个消息感到愤怒是完全可以理解的。

examples.en: She got her hair cut at a new salon downtown.
examples.zh: 她在市中心一家新的发廊剪了头发。

examples.en: The scarf was tied loosely around his neck.
examples.zh: 围巾松松地系在他的脖子上。

examples.en: Firefighters told everyone to evacuate the building.
examples.zh: 消防员叫所有人撤离这栋大楼。

examples.en: She wrote a descriptive paragraph about the beach.
examples.zh: 她写了一段描写海滩的文字。

examples.en: The family faced great hardship during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间这个家庭经历了巨大的苦难。

examples.en: We grew a large orange squash in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里种了一个大大的橙色南瓜。

examples.en: She sent me a postcard from Paris.
examples.zh: 她从巴黎给我寄了一张明信片。

examples.en: Political instability worried many investors.
examples.zh: 政治的不稳定让许多投资者感到担忧。

examples.en: It is a pity that you missed the party.
examples.zh: 你错过了聚会，真是可惜。

examples.en: The company plans to relocate to a bigger city.
examples.zh: 公司计划搬迁到一个更大的城市。

examples.en: The store is an affiliate of a large national chain.
examples.zh: 这家商店是一家大型全国连锁店的分支机构。

examples.en: The ship sailed slowly across the wide gulf.
examples.zh: 船在宽阔的海湾上缓缓航行。

examples.en: The answer to the puzzle remained elusive.
examples.zh: 这个谜题的答案仍然难以捉摸。

examples.en: He made a quick dodge to avoid the ball.
examples.zh: 他迅速一闪以躲开那个球。

examples.en: She gave her unwanted clothes to charity.
examples.zh: 她把不需要的衣服捐给了慈善机构。

examples.en: A government bureaucrat handled all the forms.
examples.zh: 一名政府官员处理了所有这些表格。

examples.en: The cat scratched the sofa with its sharp claw.
examples.zh: 猫用它锋利的爪子抓沙发。

examples.en: We had a marvelous time at the seaside.
examples.zh: 我们在海边度过了一段美妙的时光。

examples.en: Old thermometers used mercury to measure heat.
examples.zh: 旧式温度计用水银来测量温度。

examples.en: She listened to the claim with some skepticism.
examples.zh: 她带着几分怀疑听了这个说法。

examples.en: The report is still incomplete and needs more work.
examples.zh: 这份报告还不完整，需要更多工作。

examples.en: The laborer worked hard all day in the field.
examples.zh: 这名劳动者在田里辛苦干了一整天。

examples.en: It rained continuously for three days.
examples.zh: 雨连续下了三天。

examples.en: Vaccines help build immunity against disease.
examples.zh: 疫苗有助于建立对疾病的免疫力。

examples.en: Our reliance on phones grows every year.
examples.zh: 我们对手机的依赖每年都在增加。

examples.en: Scientists study planetary movement around the sun.
examples.zh: 科学家研究行星围绕太阳的运动。

examples.en: The nucleus is at the center of every cell.
examples.zh: 细胞核位于每个细胞的中心。

examples.en: This company can cater food for large weddings.
examples.zh: 这家公司能为大型婚礼提供餐饮服务。

examples.en: My brother and I play chess every weekend.
examples.zh: 我和弟弟每个周末都下国际象棋。

examples.en: The little girl has long blonde hair.
examples.zh: 那个小女孩有一头长长的金发。

examples.en: The sun shone brightly over the green hills.
examples.zh: 阳光明亮地照耀着青翠的山丘。

examples.en: A powerful tornado destroyed several houses.
examples.zh: 一场强劲的龙卷风摧毁了几座房屋。

examples.en: The camel carried water across the hot desert.
examples.zh: 骆驼驮着水穿过炎热的沙漠。

examples.en: What the heck are you doing up there?
examples.zh: 你在上面到底在搞什么鬼？

examples.en: New students must conform to the school rules.
examples.zh: 新生必须遵守学校的规定。

examples.en: Learning a new language is a worthwhile effort.
examples.zh: 学习一门新语言是值得付出的努力。

examples.en: He rolled up the cuff of his shirt sleeve.
examples.zh: 他把衬衫袖口卷了起来。

examples.en: A small bud appeared on the rose plant.
examples.zh: 玫瑰花上长出了一个小花蕾。

examples.en: The new shipment of goods arrived this morning.
examples.zh: 新一批货物今天早上到了。

examples.en: I have great admiration for her hard work.
examples.zh: 我非常钦佩她的辛勤努力。

examples.en: A new life begins when sperm meets an egg.
examples.zh: 当精子与卵子结合时，新的生命便开始了。

examples.en: They bought a comfortable family sedan.
examples.zh: 他们买了一辆舒适的家用轿车。

examples.en: Many people fought to end apartheid in South Africa.
examples.zh: 许多人为终结南非的种族隔离而斗争。

examples.en: The teacher gave a brief overview of the lesson.
examples.zh: 老师对这节课做了一个简要的概述。

examples.en: The bridge was built to withstand strong winds.
examples.zh: 这座桥的建造能够经受住强风。

examples.en: She lost one gold earring at the party.
examples.zh: 她在聚会上弄丢了一只金耳环。

examples.en: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
examples.zh: 农民用灌溉来给庄稼浇水。

examples.en: The school may expel students who cheat.
examples.zh: 学校可能会开除作弊的学生。

examples.en: Many wild animals face the threat of extinction.
examples.zh: 许多野生动物面临灭绝的威胁。

examples.en: The lab is full of scientific apparatus.
examples.zh: 实验室里满是科学仪器。

examples.en: She agreed to help, but with some reluctance.
examples.zh: 她答应帮忙，但有些不情愿。

examples.en: He asked his friend for forgiveness.
examples.zh: 他请求朋友的原谅。

examples.en: There was scarcely any food left in the house.
examples.zh: 家里几乎没剩什么食物了。

examples.en: She chopped a fresh cabbage for the soup.
examples.zh: 她切了一颗新鲜的卷心菜做汤。

examples.en: The rope hung slack between the two poles.
examples.zh: 绳子在两根杆子之间松垮地垂着。

examples.en: They bought lumber to build a new fence.
examples.zh: 他们买了木材来建一道新栅栏。

examples.en: She has traveled extensively around Asia.
examples.zh: 她在亚洲各地广泛地旅行过。

examples.en: These problems have deep societal roots.
examples.zh: 这些问题有着深刻的社会根源。

examples.en: This habit is very prevalent among young people.
examples.zh: 这种习惯在年轻人中非常普遍。

examples.en: The doctor said the tumor was benign.
examples.zh: 医生说这个肿瘤是良性的。

examples.en: She spoke calmly even during the emergency.
examples.zh: 即使在紧急情况下，她也平静地说话。

examples.en: Her dedication to the team is truly admirable.
examples.zh: 她对团队的奉献精神真令人钦佩。

examples.en: We had a big dinner on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 我们在圣诞前夜吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。

examples.en: The country is working to reduce income inequality.
examples.zh: 这个国家正努力减少收入不平等。

examples.en: They visited an important archaeological site.
examples.zh: 他们参观了一处重要的考古遗址。

examples.en: The criminals tried to kidnap the rich man's son.
examples.zh: 罪犯试图绑架那个富人的儿子。

examples.en: Rain splashed against the car windshield.
examples.zh: 雨水拍打在汽车的挡风玻璃上。

examples.en: We hiked across the rugged mountain trail.
examples.zh: 我们徒步走过崎岖的山间小路。

examples.en: Her son just started attending preschool.
examples.zh: 她的儿子刚开始上幼儿园。

examples.en: He is apt to forget things when he is busy.
examples.zh: 他忙的时候容易忘事。

examples.en: She made an earnest effort to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 她认真地努力想通过考试。

examples.en: We searched for the optimal solution to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们寻找解决这个问题的最佳方案。

examples.en: He gave a clear and coherent answer.
examples.zh: 他给出了一个清晰而连贯的回答。

examples.en: I love the simplicity of this design.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这个设计的简洁。

examples.en: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
examples.zh: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主食。

examples.en: Brushing helps remove plaque from your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙有助于清除牙齿上的牙菌斑。

examples.en: Please keep this information confidential.
examples.zh: 请对这条信息保密。

examples.en: The actor wrote an autobiography about his life.
examples.zh: 这位演员写了一本讲述他生平的自传。

examples.en: The young singer quickly became a superstar.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的歌手很快成了超级明星。

examples.en: He drove a sleek new sports car.
examples.zh: 他开着一辆线条流畅的新跑车。

examples.en: This app is compatible with most phones.
examples.zh: 这个应用与大多数手机兼容。

examples.en: She studied intensely before the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考试前她拼命地学习。

examples.en: His comment was indirectly aimed at me.
examples.zh: 他的话间接地是针对我的。

examples.en: After the tax deduction, his salary was smaller.
examples.zh: 扣除税款后，他的工资变少了。

examples.en: He poured himself a small glass of whiskey.
examples.zh: 他给自己倒了一小杯威士忌。

examples.en: The children climbed up the tall sand dune.
examples.zh: 孩子们爬上了高高的沙丘。

examples.en: Rinse the dishes with clean water before drying.
examples.zh: 擦干前先用清水冲洗碗碟。

examples.en: He shook the bottle vigorously before opening it.
examples.zh: 他在打开瓶子前用力地摇晃它。

examples.en: Good interpersonal skills help you make friends.
examples.zh: 良好的人际交往能力有助于你交朋友。

examples.en: She walked slowly down the wooden staircase.
examples.zh: 她慢慢地走下木制楼梯。

examples.en: Young children are more susceptible to colds.
examples.zh: 幼儿更容易感冒。

examples.en: His test scores were inconsistent throughout the year.
examples.zh: 他一整年的考试成绩都很不稳定。
